key_insight: Articraft treats articulated 3D asset creation as a program-synthesis task and uses LLMs as agentic program writers to automatically generate assembly code that constructs articulated objects, enabling scalable, diverse dataset generation.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the scarcity and high cost of creating large, diverse datasets of articulated 3D objects (with correct parts and kinematics), which limits learning and evaluation in perception, simulation, and robotics.
method: Reduce asset generation to writing executable ‘build’ programs that specify parts, geometry, joints, and kinematic parameters.
Introduce Articraft — an agentic system and programmatic interface/harness that guides an LLM to draft, validate, and refine these build-programs (including simulation/render checks).
Automate assembly, kinematic specification, and export to standard asset formats to produce large, diverse collections with minimal human intervention.
impact: Provides a practical route to synthesize massive, varied articulated 3D datasets for training and benchmarking models, lowering manual modeling costs and accelerating progress in embodied AI, simulation, and robotics research.
